2 خوّد , (L,) inf. n. تَخْوِيدٌ, (S, L, K,) He (a camel, L) went quickly; or was quick in his pace or going: (S, L, K:) he went quickly, and threw out his legs: or, as some say, he shook, as though he were convulsed: and in like manner, a male ostrich: and sometimes it is said of a man, signifying as first explained above. (L.) ―
-b2- خَوَّدَ رَأْلُهُ: see art. رأل. ＝
-A2- He sent the stallion, فِىالإِبِلِ among the camels. (L, K.) ＝
-A3- He obtained somewhat of food. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
